messages:
alex: Heads up — we've got a v2 streaming schema canary scheduled for 10:00 PT (in ~12m). Deploybot will kick off the staged rollout (region: us-west, batch size: 5%). Plan is: gateway header gate + streaming-shim to preserve long-poll semantics. @mira @sam please eyeball telemetry.
deploybot: Deploy queued: run=api-rollout/v2, strategy=staged, batches=[5%,25%,50%,100%]. Preflight checks passed. Starting at 10:00 PT.
mira: Quick note — staging flagged a small regress on long-poll clients: chunked frames were re-ordered when clients used older ws proxies. Seems isolated to legacy mobile SDKs.
sam: Got it. How big of a regression? Error types? 4xx/5xx?
mira: Mostly 5xx (stream disconnects) and ~0.6% token drop on mobile-staging. I can attach logs if useful but short: gateway was normal, downstream model instances fine.
alex: Thanks. Two options: 1) proceed with header-gate + deploy shim on gateway that normalizes frame boundaries (fast), 2) pause rollout and iterate on runtime fix (slower). We need decision in next 6m.
sam: Given low impact, prefer shim + ramp. We should add a temporary client pin header for tenants known to be fragile. Example to pin to v1 for risky tenants:
```bash
# gateway rule example
if request.headers['X-Client-Compat'] in ['mobile-v0','legacy-sdk']:
  set request.headers['X-Api-Version'] = 'v1'
```
alex: +1 on header pin and shim. Ops: can you prepare a deploybot flag to exclude pinned tenants from batches? deploybot, can we attach a pinlist to run?
ops-bot: ops-note: added pinlist support. To attach: `deploybot run --pinlist /configs/pinlist/v1-exempt.json`. Manual opt-out available.
deploybot: Acknowledged. Patch applied: rollout supports --pinlist. Will skip tenants in /configs/pinlist/v1-exempt.json.
mira: I'll update the pinlist now with tenants we've seen in staging logs and add 2 demo customers (they have a big presentation today).
sam: Rollback criteria we agreed on last week still apply: >1% region 5xx sustained for 10m OR critical customer errors flagged by CS. Confirming those triggers remain.
alex: Confirmed. I'll publish a short release note addendum to call out the shim and the temporary pin behaviour so platform teams and integrations know what to expect.
mira: Patch + pinlist uploaded. Starting canary with pinlist attached.
deploybot: Deploy started: batch=5% (us-west). Pinlist=/configs/pinlist/v1-exempt.json. Observability hooks enabled.
sam: Watching traces. Initial 5m looks stable, no spike in 5xx. Streaming latencies nominal.
ops-bot: Note — customer demo (tenant: zen-demo) scheduled 10:30 PT has been pinned to v1 per list.
alex: Great. If we stay green for 20m, we proceed to 25% and re-evaluate. If anything crosses rollback criteria, we pause and roll back automatically.
deploybot: Update: 5m mark — batch healthy. Next stage scheduled in 15m unless a pause is requested.
mira: One small request: add a short blurb to release notes about temporary behavior for older SDKs and how customers can opt into v2 by updating header. I'll paste copy in #release-notes after this
